reference.pathophysiology: Throbbing metaphyseal pain with fever and refused movement in children names acute haematogenous for culture-first anti-staph cover while sickle infarcts name Salmonella for gram-neg plans; detached dead bone with wrapping sheath and draining holes names sequestrum-involucrum-cloacae for sequestrectomy-saucerisation, and sclerotic small cavities name Brodie for curettage while probe-to-bone ulcers name diabetic foot osteomyelitis for deep biopsy.
additionalDifferentials: Acute versus chronic versus Brodie by duration sinus and sclerosis
Vertebral versus diabetic versus prosthetic by endplate probe and biofilm
Sequestrum versus involucrum versus cloacae by dead sheath and hole
